genius.notes: BRL1 is a Brazilian-real payment stablecoin developed by a consortium and listed on OKX Europe, but public materials do not identify a single legal issuer or any U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, state qualification, or foreign-issuer registration as of 2026-08-14. The issuer/pathway and foreign-exception posture therefore remain unknown.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS approval, official application, state-qualified approval, or registered foreign-issuer exception was located for BRL1 or the BRL1 consortium as of 2026-08-14. Public materials establish a Brazilian-real payment token and reserve/redemption disclosures, but not a U.S. GENIUS filing or registration.
